why: Models issue #492's defect exactly: `replayMetaFor` stamping the SHIPPED default instead of reading the rule off the world, which is what the meta did while it omitted the field entirely. Deliberately silent -- the trace still parses, the data fingerprint still reports a match (it covers the four sim JSON files and says nothing about which rules a world was built under), and only the AI's target selection moves. Measured on the branch that landed this, against the 32 cases replay.test.ts held before the regression coverage was written: 0 failed, so the omission really was invisible. Killed by the two cases added with it -- the first pins the RECORD side (the meta reads 'line-of-sight' off a world built with it), the second the REBUILD side end to end (rebuild from the meta alone, replay the recorded trace, and the AI commits to different opponents than a rebuild at 'full' does).
killedBy: replayMetaFor reads aiTargetPerception off the world too, when the line-of-sight bound was requested (issue #492)
replayTrace round-trips the AI perception rule, and a rebuild at the shipped default fights DIFFERENT opponents (issue #492)
